title: Limitation period - the silent killer of strong civil cases
p1:
A case can be strong, the facts can be clear, and the evidence can be solid… yet it can still fail before it even begins.

The reason? A deadline most people ignore.
p2:
Many believe that having a genuine legal claim is enough to get justice anytime. The surprising truth is that courts often reject valid claims simply because they were filed too late.

The limitation period is the legal time limit within which you must take action.
p3:
Think of it as a countdown clock. Once the clock runs out, even a powerful case may lose its chance in court.

The mistake many people make is waiting for the “perfect time” to act. Delays in collecting documents, sending notices, or seeking legal advice can quietly damage your rights.

The practical lesson: knowing your deadline is just as important as knowing your facts. A strong case needs timely action to survive.
conclusion: Have you ever seen a genuine claim fail because someone waited too long to take legal action?
